description: This file defines the MaintenanceDao class within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin, responsible for data extraction related to employee numbers from specified tables. It extends a BaseDao class and contains a method to build and execute a database query based on provided match criteria.

classes.name: MaintenanceDao
classes.description: DAO class for maintenance-related data retrieval, extending the BaseDao class.

methods.name: extractDataFromEmpNumber
methods.description: Extracts data from a specified table based on employee number and optional join conditions.
